concept: Reframe a national homebuilder website as a guided homebuyer product that begins with lifestyle priorities and leads to markets, plans, personalization and a local visit.
audience: Prospective new-home buyers who need to understand where to look, what kind of home fits and what happens next without parsing an inventory database first.
promise: The website turns a complicated housing search into a small sequence of useful choices while preserving access to official live inventory.

scenes.purpose: Give the buyer a useful starting point
scenes.subject: Market, home type and move-in timing search
scenes.copy: Find the home your life fits into.
scenes.interaction: Choose priorities and run the guided search
scenes.transitionIn: arrive on a welcoming residential image
scenes.transitionOut: search moves the buyer into market paths

scenes.purpose: Replace undifferentiated inventory with understandable paths
scenes.subject: Market pathways with direct access to official live search
scenes.copy: Do not start with a list. Start with your life.

scenes.purpose: Explain how a home lives before showing raw dimensions
scenes.subject: Illustrative plan pathways and lifestyle fit
scenes.interaction: Add a plan path to comparison

scenes.purpose: Turn Design, Choice and Service into a coherent operating model
scenes.subject: Three connected company principles
